keyPhrases.text: Jeff Daniels makes Alan as entertaining as he would be insufferable in real life
Hope Davis exquisitely charts her evolution
ideally represented by a dashing, droll Rupert Everett
Christine Ebersole's Elvira is, disappointingly, more problematic
makes some wisecracks hard to decipher
you'll find flickers of heaven in her performance

reasoning: Predominantly positive review with enthusiastic praise for performances and productions. Contains some specific criticisms (Christine Ebersole's delivery issues) but overall tone is appreciative and recommending. Strong positive language throughout with minor reservations places this in 4/5 star range.
